title: 29.x: PO matching API, E-Documents integration and receipt-on-invoice line tracking
summary: Backport to 29.x that adds a purchase order matching API to the Base Application, with receipt-on-invoice line tracking and a Receipt on Invoice Policy enum. E-Documents PO matching now uses this API. Purchase, vendor and upgrade objects were updated across localization layers.
key_points: New Base Application codeunits for PO matching, matching groups, matched order lines and invoiceable receipts
New Receipt on Invoice Policy enum, plus changes to Vendor, Vendor Card, Purchase Line and Purchase Order Subform
E-Doc. PO Matching reworked and E-Doc PO Match Warning enum extended
Upgrade codeunits and upgrade tags added in several layers
